reason: The README describes a DSH web interface plugin for replacing logos, editing badge text, and persisting these visual customizations locally, so themes-layout is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 用于自定义 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面品牌区域的插件，可替换标志图片、编辑徽章文字并在浏览器本地保存设置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web interface plugin for replacing brand images, editing badge text, and saving these customizations in browser storage.

capabilities: customizes branding elements in the DSH web interface
allows users to select local images for logo replacement
stores customization values in browser localStorage
edits the HARNESS badge text and synchronizes the browser tab title
